scope: Conditional pilot only if fresh development captures show selection headroom; existing five-layer backbone and codebooks frozen; adapt only selector hidden projection through a merged rank8 update.
split: Task-family development/validation/test assignment in protocol.json is frozen before capture. Final test metrics remain uninspected until checkpoint selection is frozen.
loss: Reached-prefix candidate CE plus0.25 KL(baseline candidate distribution || current), position decay exp(-position/8). Train and candidate evaluation keep natural top16 support; unsupported labels are counted and excluded from candidate CE.
sampling: Case-balanced replacement sampling within development only, shared sampled-example sequence across arms.
selection: Validation fixed-continuation prefix yield on complete-reference cycles; this is an off-policy proxy, never a rollout throughput claim. Re-evaluate selected export with native loader and real rollouts before final-test conclusions.
controls: Frozen zero-update export must retain original BF16 tensor bytes; existing PR551 quantizer must match independent native-loader reference; native target/codebooks/backbone files must match original.
native_gate: Improvement must survive natural native rollouts, full cycle cost and uncertainty, unchanged greedy target outputs, sampling/state tests, TTFT and memory review. No automatic default change from offline metrics.
numerical_control: Training and proxy scores anchor to captured native edges plus the change in computed context gate. This subtracts the same forward baseline to remove CPU/Metal accumulation mismatch. All exports are subsequently evaluated through native AF4 preparation.
